skills.description: Captures learnings, errors, and corrections to enable continuous improvement. Use when: (1) A command or operation fails unexpectedly, (2) User corrects Claude ('No, that's wrong...', 'Actually...'), (3) User requests a capability that doesn't exist, (4) An external API or tool fails, (5) Claude realizes its knowledge is outdated or incorrect, (6) A better approach is discovered for a recurring task. Also review learnings before major tasks.
skills.description_zh: 捕获学习内容、错误和纠正以实现持续改进。使用时机：(1) 命令或操作意外失败，(2) 用户纠正 Claude（"不对..."、"实际上..."），(3) 用户请求不存在的功能，(4) 外部 API 或工具失败，(5) Claude 意识到知识过时或不准确，(6) 发现更好的方法处理重复任务。重大任务前也需回顾学习内容。
skills.name: Self Improving Agent 1.0.1
